about.title: Campbell Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Campbell's mix of freeway traffic off SR-17 and steady local flow along San Tomas Expressway and Hamilton Avenue means collisions happen in all sorts of settings, from a sudden freeway merge to a stop-and-go backup near a Friday evening rush. Santa Clara County's most recent full-year figures show 107 injury collisions in Campbell, with 124 people hurt, a reminder that these crashes touch real lives, not just statistics. LawProactive isn't a law firm, but we help injured Campbell residents connect quickly with an independent personal injury attorney who can look at what happened, gather the evidence while it's still fresh, and explain your options under California law. There's no cost to get connected, and attorneys in our network work on contingency, meaning they're paid only if you recover compensation. Reaching out early, before talking to any insurance adjuster, can make a real difference in protecting your claim.

whyChoose.title: Why Act Sooner Rather Than Later

items.title: California's Filing Clock Is Real
items.desc: You generally have two years from the crash date to file a personal injury lawsuit in California, but if a government vehicle or roadway defect was involved, that window can shrink to as little as six months. Waiting too long can close off your options entirely.

items.title: Comparative Fault Can Work Against You
items.desc: California allows recovery even if you're partly at fault, but your compensation gets reduced by your share of blame. An early, well-documented account of what happened at intersections like Hamilton Avenue helps protect against an insurer overstating your responsibility.

items.title: No Recorded Statement Without Guidance
items.desc: Insurance adjusters often ask for a recorded statement soon after a crash, and anything you say can be used to minimize your claim. An independent attorney can advise you before you speak with any insurer, so your words aren't used against you later.

items.question: Do I need to talk to the other driver's insurance company right away?
items.answer: No, you're not required to give a recorded statement to the other side's insurer before speaking with an attorney. Insurance adjusters are trained to ask questions that can shrink your claim, so it's wise to get guidance first. LawProactive can help connect you with an attorney who can speak on your behalf.

items.question: What if my crash happened on SR-17 or another state highway near Campbell?
items.answer: Crashes on state routes like SR-17 can sometimes involve Caltrans or other government entities, which carry a much shorter claim-filing deadline, sometimes just six months. It's important to have someone review the crash details and location quickly. An independent attorney can help determine whether a government claim applies to your situation.

items.question: How much does it cost to get connected with an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free service, and attorneys in our network work on contingency, meaning they only get paid if you receive a settlement or award. There's no upfront cost or obligation to move forward after you're connected.
